description: Compare one continuously rented GPU with API inference using explicit GPU hourly and API token rates plus measured output throughput. Returns cost, breakeven and capacity checks. Supplied rates are scenario assumptions; unresolved stored GPU prices cannot produce a quote.

api_cost_per_1m_out.description: Explicit API output cost per 1M tokens; required with a supplied GPU rate.

gpu_hourly_cost_usd.description: Explicit GPU cost in USD/hour. Requires API rate and measured throughput; bypasses unresolved stored GPU prices without treating this input as verified.

gpu_provider.description: Optional scenario label when supplying a rate; stored provider rows require their own source review.

gpu_type.description: Optional scenario hardware label when supplying a rate.

operational_overhead_pct.description: Ops overhead % on GPU cost (default 40; explicit 0 is honored)

throughput_tokens_per_sec.description: Measured output tokens/second for one GPU on your workload; required with a supplied GPU rate. No model/GPU benchmark is inferred.

name: self-host-breakeven-calculator
